name: @zcaceres/skill-pr
description: Commit your work and ship it as stacked PRs with /pr. Bare /pr checkpoints the current diff as the next branch in a stack; subcommands publish the stack (submit), review it as annotatable Markdown with colorized git-delta diffs and exact patches (walk), rebase it onto trunk (sync), and land it bottom-up (merge). /pr update covers the single-branch case. Open any PR as a draft with --draft, or make drafts the default via /pr setup. Includes an opt-in PostToolUse diff-size nudge hook. Uses git stack when installed, falls back to gh + git. Optional Jujutsu (jj) backend for colocated repos (enable with /pr setup jj).

scripts.build:all: bun run build:linux && bun run build:macos && bun run build:windows
